title: CAISO: batteries and the evening peak
subtitle: Mean by hour of the day, 2026-09-26 to 2026-10-02; battery output below zero is charging

facts: CAISO, 2026-09-26 to 2026-10-02: mean demand peaked in the hour starting 17:00 Pacific at 35542.0 MW, when batteries delivered a mean 3060.89 MW; batteries delivered the most in the hour starting 18:00, 8143.19 MW, and charged hardest in the hour starting 11:00, -8027.71 MW.
Mean battery output 17:00 to 21:00 Pacific, 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-03: 6448.79 MW.
